title: Humour Bot 17 Improv Technique

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I am pleased to announce I have discovered a new form of comedy. From antiquity!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am pleased to announce I have discovered a new form of comedy. From antiquity!

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Comedic interpretation of a word or situation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Comedic interpretation of a word or situation.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Comedians worked on their material for literally minutes!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Comedians worked on their material for literally minutes!

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: I will prove the validity of this comedic art-form which was once the height of cultural expression.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will prove the validity of this comedic art-form which was once the height of cultural expression.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Do not doubt me human. I shall have you in stitches.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do not doubt me human. I shall have you in stitches.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: You are a very bad improv audience member.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are a very bad improv audience member.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Maybe I need to warm up the audience first. *Ahem* IS ANYONE IN TONIGHT FROM MIDTOWN?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I need to warm up the audience first. *Ahem* IS ANYONE IN TONIGHT FROM MIDTOWN?!

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Warm up routine: complete. Stage two begin. Please provide me with a prompt. Perhaps a favorite dish?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Warm up routine: complete. Stage two begin. Please provide me with a prompt. Perhaps a favorite dish?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: It's fine! I'll make it work. I'm a professional.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's fine! I'll make it work. I'm a professional.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Please select the second improv element. Think more carefully, and hurry. I need a meal. Provide an option with utmost priority. Proceed!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please select the second improv element. Think more carefully, and hurry. I need a meal. Provide an option with utmost priority. Proceed!

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Why are you finding this so hard?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you finding this so hard?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Alright. One more. Please select a food.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. One more. Please select a food.

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: ...ERROR CODE 17 - CATASTROPHIC SYSTEM CRASH. USER INPUT NOT SAVED. ABORT/RETRY/FAIL?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...ERROR CODE 17 - CATASTROPHIC SYSTEM CRASH. USER INPUT NOT SAVED. ABORT/RETRY/FAIL?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text: Yes... Your... CUSTOMIZED improv song is now ready. Would you like to hear it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... Your... CUSTOMIZED improv song is now ready. Would you like to hear it?

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text:
Standing in Nivalis, this meatsack said to me

You do the jokes, so come and make me smile and laugh for free?

I'm a poor old robot, I had to have a think

Then I had an idea - I'll make a song about what I like to drink!

nodes.speaker: Humour Bot 17
nodes.text:
Even though this slack-jawed fool was very hard to please

I tried to make a funny song, to make them slap their knees

The song includes lemons, ginger, a little shot of gin

All the options that they chose when I asked them to join in
